url.q: ?q=<ezanaql text> restores the last query and its result table; omitted for the default query
url.signal: ?signal=<event id> opens the carousel on that event; replaceState as the user flips
url.member: ?member=<slug> opens the member drawer; one history entry per drawer; swapping member replaces it

nav: shared component per 06-SHARED-NAV.md; this page sets Capitol Watch as active and nothing else

states: typed (question shown, emerald border and halo, solid button)
ran (query block updated, results card refreshed)
bar.prompts: Try chips fill the bar and generate immediately
bar.query_block: mono, shows the generated EzanaQL; Edit opens an inline editor in the same light block; Run re-runs; Saved reports opens this hub's saved list

results_card.default: on load, shows the default query's result so the card is never empty
results_card.scroll: the table scrolls inside the card; header row stays visible
results_card.ticker_click: opens the existing company card (federal contracts and which members hold it)

actions.Save: saves the report to this hub's Saved list (account-gated if Saved needs an account today)
actions.Open full table: navigates to the full results view

results_card.signed_out: gated actions show a lock and open the centred account modal

states.error: This query could not run just now. Check it or try again.

top_signals.source: high-signal events this week across Capitol datasets plus the user's saved rules
top_signals.order: rankHighSignalEvents: linked-dataset count desc, then flagged date desc
top_signals.view: one event at a time, full width

navigation.arrows: previous and next; wrap at the ends
navigation.counter: N OF TOTAL for the active filter
navigation.preview_strip: five cards: current plus the next four; clicking one jumps to it; the strip pages forward as the user advances
navigation.keyboard: Left and Right arrows when the carousel has focus; the region has aria-roledescription=carousel and each event aria-roledescription=slide with 'N of TOTAL'

top_signals.auto_advance: none (respects reading time and reduced motion)

card.reasons: one per linked dataset, each with the fact, date, amount and dataset label
card.chart: 60 days of daily closes, dashed award line, trade marker, 30 days after the trade drawn heavier in green (gain) or red (loss); crosshair on hover and keyboard with date and close
card.facts: four, event-type dependent (trade before award: 30D return, Award, Oversight, Agency)
card.actions: Watchlist (gated), Query this (opens EzanaQL with the event's query), Share

rule_builder.placement: under the carousel; expanded by default for first-time visitors, collapsible; remembers collapsed state per viewer

step_1_datasets.rule: minimum two selected; an event qualifies only when every selected dataset has a record for the same company or member
step_1_datasets.unsupported_join: chip renders with a PREVIEW tag and a dashed border; selectable only when the data layer supports the join
step_1_datasets.overlap_preview: linked chips of the current selection

conditions.label: Trade within {N} of an award to the same company
Member's committee oversees the company's sector
Trade amount at least {X} (disclosed range floor)

step_2_conditions.visibility: a condition shows only when the datasets it requires are selected
step_2_conditions.plain_english: hands the rule to EzanaQL, which shows the generated query and fills the conditions it can map

step_3_preview.list: first three matches with ticker, one-line description, 30D return; '+N more' opens them in the carousel under My signals
step_3_preview.name: required to save; default suggested from the conditions
step_3_preview.save: account-gated; on save the rule appears as a My signals chip and its events join the carousel
step_3_preview.alert: account-gated; daily email when a new event matches
step_3_preview.signed_out: preview fully works; Save and Alert show a lock and open the account modal

rule_builder.my_signals_chips: click filters the carousel to that rule; a menu offers Edit, Rename, Pause alerts, Delete

signals_panel.a11y: role=tablist; arrow keys move between tabs
signals_panel.row_actions: Watchlist / Save (gated), Query this, Share on every row
signals_panel.per_tab_footer: time window and named sources, always

heatmap.cell: button; shade from the share; value printed; title gives committee, sector and share
heatmap.select: outlines the cell and fills the detail box: committee by sector, share, N of M members, holders with tickers and last trade, Query this cell
heatmap.keyboard: arrow keys move across cells; Enter selects

leaderboard.quick_step: badge appears next to qualifying traders; hover or tap explains it; signed-in users with a linked brokerage see their own progress in the explainer box
leaderboard.row_click: member rows open the member drawer; insiders, institutions and whales open their own profile when one exists

member_drawer.content: identity, committees, four stats, tabs Signals Trades Holdings Committees Donors, signals involving the member, recent trades, holdings that won awards, sources
member_drawer.behaviour: Escape and scrim close; focus returns to the opener; Open full page links to the member page

states.loading: each module streams in on its own with skeleton bars
states.empty: honest copy saying what fills it
states.error: This signal could not be loaded just now. It refreshes on its own; reload in a minute.
states.signed_out: account actions show a lock and open the centred account modal
states.preview: PREVIEW tag on modules or chips fed by datasets not fully live
states.reduced_motion: no chart draw-in, no carousel slide animation
